definitions.full: H6613. pethay [ מְּתָי ] noun [masculine] breadth ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Egyptian Aramaic RES 246 S-C D4 ); — suffix מְּתָיֵהּ Dan 3:1 ; Ezra 6:3 .
